repair: Replace sf3 with two factors. Use “full-attendance status,” with the source-exact levels “full attendance” and “not full attendance,” as an EFFECT_MODIFIER for the interaction models. Add a separate STRATIFIER for the ECLC classes “full attenders,” “partial attenders,” and “non-attenders” used in the external-validity analysis. Remove iu2 from the instrument_use_ids of o3 and o4 because those outcomes come from behavioral and feedback indicators, not from the EQ-5D-5L valuation target. repair: Keep METHODS_RESEARCH as the primary family. Add VALUE_SET_DEVELOPMENT as a secondary purpose because the study estimates and reports three experience-scale value sets, while stating that they are not standard EQ-5D-Y-3L value sets. Move PREFERENCE_COMPARISON to the next rank. Split the experience-scaling method use so that one use records it as the CURRENT_STUDY_OBJECT and another records its DIRECT_CURRENT_ACTIVITY with MAPPING_OR_DERIVATION. Revise mo1 to state that three subgroup-specific conditional logit models were estimated and that each model contained ten incremental effects and two scaling terms, one for kaizen tasks and one for paired comparisons. Add the principal author interpretation that separating HRQoL from life expectancy avoids assigning smaller life-extension gains to groups with lower baseline HRQoL and responds to the stated QALY discrimination concern. Add the reported limitation that adult valuations of child HRQoL can differ by elicited perspective and that the resource-allocation authority usually rests with the general population rather than mothers or fathers.
